title: Too Small - Broken upon Arrival
text: Too Small - Broken upon Arrival. This is a chair for a child of no more than 4' in height. It is much smaller than anticipated for our 12 year old daughter of 90lbs and 5'0". Aside from that, it did not work right out of the box. Neither adjustment knobs worked at all. Even if they did work, the chair was way too small for a child of this age and size.
